title: 동사 + 사람 + to 동사원형 (I want you to come.)
goal: want / ask / tell + 사람 + to 동사원형으로 '누가 ~하기를 원하다, ~해 달라고 부탁하다, ~하라고 말하다'를 말할 수 있어요.

points.title: '다른 사람이 ~하기를'
points.body: I want to come.은 '내가 오고 싶다', I want you to come.은 '네가 오기를 원해'예요. 동사와 to 사이에 사람을 넣으면, 그 사람이 하는 일이 돼요.

points.title: 사람 자리는 me / you / him / her / us / them
points.body: 사람 자리에는 I, he, she가 아니라 me, him, her, us, them을 써요. She asked me to help.(O) / She asked I to help.(X)

points.title: 자주 쓰는 동사
points.body: want(원하다), would like(~해 주셨으면 하다), ask(부탁하다), tell(말하다, 시키다), need(필요하다), allow(허락하다). 모두 '동사 + 사람 + to + 동사원형'으로 써요.

points.title: that 문장으로 만들지 않기
points.body: 한국어 '네가 ~하길 원해'를 I want that you ~로 옮기면 틀려요. I want you to ~로 써요.

points.title: '~하지 말라고' = not to
points.body: to 앞에 not을 넣어요. My manager told me not to be late.(매니저가 늦지 말라고 했어요.)

formula: 주어 + want / would like / need + 사람 + to + 동사원형
주어 + ask / tell / allow + 사람 + to + 동사원형
주어 + tell / ask + 사람 + not to + 동사원형

mistakes.wrong: I want that you come to the party.
mistakes.right: I want you to come to the party.
mistakes.why: 한국어 순서대로 that 문장을 만드는 실수예요. want + 사람(you) + to + 동사원형으로 써요.

mistakes.wrong: My manager told me come early.
mistakes.right: My manager told me to come early.
mistakes.why: 사람(me) 뒤에 to를 빠뜨리기 쉬워요. tell + 사람 + to + 동사원형.

mistakes.wrong: She asked I to help her.
mistakes.right: She asked me to help her.
mistakes.why: 사람 자리에는 I가 아니라 me를 써요.

examples.en: I want you to come to my party.
examples.ko: 네가 내 파티에 와 줬으면 해.

examples.en: My manager asked me to work on Saturday.
She told us to wait outside.
I'd like you to meet my housemate, Jake.
The farmer told them not to touch the machine.
examples.ko: 농장 주인이 그들에게 기계를 만지지 말라고 했어요.

examples.en: Can you ask him to call me back?
examples.ko: 그에게 저한테 다시 전화해 달라고 전해 주실래요?

examples.en: My parents want me to come home soon.
examples.ko: 부모님은 제가 곧 집에 돌아오길 바라세요.

examples.en: Our landlord doesn't allow us to have pets.
examples.ko: 집주인이 우리가 반려동물 키우는 걸 허락하지 않아요.

quiz.sentence: My boss wants me ___ early tomorrow.
quiz.ko: 사장님은 제가 내일 일찍 오길 원해요.

quiz.sentence: She asked ___ to close the shop.
quiz.ko: 그녀가 저에게 가게 문을 닫아 달라고 부탁했어요.
의사가 그에게 담배를 피우지 말라고 했어요.
quiz.why: '~하지 말라고'는 tell + 사람 + not to + 동사원형.

quiz.sentence: Can you tell ___ to call me?
quiz.why: tell 바로 뒤 사람 자리에는 her를 써요.

quiz.answer: I want you to be happy.
choices: I want you to be happy.
I want that you are happy.
quiz.why: want + 사람 + to + 동사원형(be). that 문장은 쓰지 않아요.

quiz.ko: 그녀가 우리에게 조용히 해 달라고 부탁했어요.
quiz.answer: She asked us to be quiet.
choices: She asked us to be quiet.
She asked we to be quiet.
She asked to us be quiet.

quiz.answer: My manager told me not to be late.
choices: My manager told me not to be late.
My manager told me to not late.
My manager told me don't be late.
My manager told me not be late.

quiz.answer: I need you to sign this form.
choices: I need you to sign this form.
I need that you sign this form.
I need you sign this form.
I need your to sign this form.

quiz.answer: They asked me to stay longer.
choices: They asked me to stay longer.
They asked I to stay longer.
They asked me to stayed longer.
quiz.why: ask + me + to + 동사원형. 과거라도 to 뒤는 원형.

quiz.answer: My housemate wants me to clean the bathroom.
choices: My housemate wants me to clean the bathroom.
My housemate wants me clean the bathroom.
My housemate wants that I clean the bathroom.
My housemate want me to clean the bathroom.
quiz.why: want + 사람 + to + 동사원형. 주어가 한 명이라 wants.
